name: dnsdumpster
description: Looks each domain you add to the targets up with DNSDumpster's API and lists the host names and IP addresses it knows of under Targets → Related, with their DNS details in the Entity Explorer. It sends the target's domain name to api.dnsdumpster.com, a third-party service, and needs your DNSDumpster API key (free accounts get one).

settings.label: DNSDumpster API key
settings.description: From your account page at dnsdumpster.com. It is kept in reProxy's secrets file, readable only by you, sent only to api.dnsdumpster.com, and never recorded in the traffic list.

settings.label: List the IP addresses too
settings.description: On: each address a name resolves to is listed as well, with its ASN, country and reverse name. Off: host names only.

settings.label: Include mail servers (MX records)
settings.description: Usually a mail provider's hosts rather than the target's own.

settings.label: Include name servers (NS records)
settings.description: Usually a DNS provider's hosts rather than the target's own.

settings.label: Pages to fetch per domain
settings.description: A free account gets one page (50 records). A Plus account gets 200 records per page and can ask for more pages (at most 10); each takes one request, two seconds apart.
